title: Envelope
description: Canonical JSON response envelope (constitution §14). Every component output method and every flow run returns this. `data` holds one of the 14 contract payloads; polymorphic validation is performed against the specific contract schema (see contracts.md), not enforced inline so each contract remains independently machine-validatable.

status.description: §14 status. ok = data holds the payload; error = error holds detail; pending_approval = approval_ref identifies the approval to fulfill (§19).

code.description: Stable AR_* code (§9). Callers branch on code, never on free-text parsing.

data.description: One of the 14 contract payloads (present on status=ok, describes the proposed action on pending_approval). Secrets are never present (§16).

detail.description: Opaque diagnostic context; raw exceptions are never leaked (§9).

trace_id.description: Correlates one AR run across nodes (§12).

approval_ref.description: Required on status=pending_approval (identifies the approval to fulfill, §19; non-reusable: one ref authorizes exactly one idempotent action). Empty/absent on ok or error — §14's canonical example renders this as the empty string, so the empty value is permitted even though a present ref must match the ar-approval-<uuid> shape.
